scope: Deterministic unit verification of the A4 R05 10x-tight repeat control, plus regression of exact W2 insertion through hubbard_u_pot.

protocol.approved_threshold_rule: When fixed-U R05 is active, the explicit test-only flag fixed_u_test_tighten_r05 selects both density and potential residual targets at 1e-8 Ry-compatible units, each 10x below the default 1e-7; the three-update streak remains exactly 3. When fixed-U R05 is inactive (including U=0 external-W), code must log NOT APPLICABLE and must not silently apply tightened thresholds.
protocol.default_production_behavior: Flag defaults false; ordinary thresholds remain 1e-7 for both residuals and streak 3.

unit_criteria.expected_default: three successive residual pairs meet default thresholds and the third update converges
unit_criteria.expected_tight: the same residual pair exceeds both tight thresholds, so the streak remains zero and convergence is false
unit_criteria.w2_regression: W2 exact matrix and lambda=0.25 insertion are binary-exact; verify exact Hermiticity, both same-spin d blocks, and exact zero untouched/cross-spin carrier entries
